reads.note: read from account.wishes (localStorage 'fw-account') by id. WishContent = {letter,reasons,memory,story,voices,note,blessing,timeline,details,credits,links,studio,by,partner,gift,finale{line,sign},off[],on[],opening{id,values,scene},ending{id,values,scene},cover{more,school,years,born}} (lib/wish-model.ts:147). fromWish() turns it into WishData; if no content.letter it splits w.letter on blank lines; reasons from w.reasons; sets finale.sign from w.from. strict when content.on exists.

fields.name: chapters

payload.name: reaction
payload.type: string ('Yes.' when value=='yes'; else the raw value e.g. 'no')

actions.note: Host.hear -> onReaction(value) fires on EndingEvent type 'answer'. Today written by the receiver page into the signed-in account's own wish (putWish(account,{...w,reaction}), and skipped if no account). With a server the receiver is anonymous and must reach the sender via the link. Note No also overwrites reaction with 'no'; 'reached' and 'done' events are not stored.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: account===undefined or id===null (browser storage still being read), or guest present with reveal===undefined (getReveal pending)
uiStatesHandled.note: after the move to a server this is the loading state; today it is a blank page, not a skeleton. The getReveal wait is a promise over local data so is near instant.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: !w and no guest query, or !data: 'That wish is not here. It may have been made on another phone, or erased.' + My wishes link
uiStatesHandled.note: this is the error/empty equivalent; it is exactly what any receiver sees on another device (STUB-9)

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: w.status=='resting': 'This wish is resting. It was made for <name>. Wake it for a month, six months or a year, and it plays again.' with cover photo (w.photos[0] or /img/aisha-1.webp), eyebrow 'Wish № <no>' or 'A wish', Wake it link
uiStatesHandled.note: shows to anyone opening the link; the Wake it button is a sender action and should not show to a receiver
fromContent with RevealPlay photos/content/date; onFavourites wired

uiStatesHandled.state: playing a client wish by name
uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: !w and guest and guest.reveal falsy (null: no ?no= or getReveal rejected/returned null)
uiStatesHandled.note: sample words filled with the name; style default 'cinema' for kind 'teams', else 'noir'

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: w found, status != 'resting'; WishHost preview, onReaction, close link to /app/wishes/<id>
uiStatesHandled.note: draft, sealed, live and removed wishes all play; status is not checked beyond 'resting'

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: opening.id=='sealed' and sealTime(opening)>Date.now() (left>0); button hidden unless preview
uiStatesHandled.note: Gate shows 'Sealed until <time>, <long date>' and countdown text; unlock() ignored while left>0 unless preview

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: opening.id=='countdown' and left>0; Open it button shown regardless (unlock only blocked for lock=='time')

errors: 'Type the code first.' (empty), 'That is not the code.'; if values.code empty it opens with no check
errors: 'Type your answer first.', 'That is not it. Try again.'; compare is tidy(): NFKD, strip accents, trim, lowercase, collapse spaces, strip . ! ? , ' ’ "

stubsObserved.evidence: account?.wishes.find((x)=>x.id===id) from useAccount (localStorage 'fw-account'); header comment 'until a server holds the wish itself'
stubsObserved.standsInFor: fetching the wish by its public link
stubsObserved.consequence: STUB-9: the Share link works only in the sender's own browser; any other device shows 'That wish is not here'

stubsObserved.evidence: 'a business's client wish named in the address ... plays its occasion with that name until a server holds the wish itself' -> fromContent({..., photos: [], content: {}, fill: true})
stubsObserved.consequence: the client sees sample words with their name, not what the business wrote, unless ?no= resolves a reveal on the same device

stubsObserved.standsInFor: a server-decided resting/gone state for a receiver
stubsObserved.consequence: a receiver is shown a sender's action; 'gone' (erased after HOLD_DAYS) and 'removed' are not distinguished: removed wishes still play

stubsObserved.standsInFor: POST of the receiver's answer to the wish's sender
stubsObserved.consequence: reaction is never delivered to anyone but the signed-in owner's own browser; a receiver's Yes is lost

stubsObserved.evidence: sendFavourites writes hearts into fw-vault/fw-pro on this device (loadPro/savePro)
stubsObserved.consequence: hearts only reach the business if the client opens the reveal in the business's own browser

stubsObserved.evidence: getReveal reads loadPro()/shootsHere() and falls back to sample shoots; frames without a local src are dropped
stubsObserved.consequence: a client elsewhere gets null and then the sample client wish; frames larger than ~200 chars of src are not kept in the record
voice note exists only on the sender's device

stubsObserved.standsInFor: the wedding day stored with the wish
stubsObserved.consequence: countdown target for a Wedding is lost off device; must be a field of the wish

stubsObserved.evidence: checkUnlock compares the typed answer to wish.opening.values.code / .answer locally; header comment: 'Today the passcode and the answer are checked against the wish's own values on this device'
stubsObserved.standsInFor: server-side passcode/question check (secret never sent to receiver)
stubsObserved.consequence: the code/answer ships to every receiver's browser inside WishData; anyone can read it. Time seal is judged by receiver's device clock (Date.now()), not server time.

stubsObserved.evidence: sealTime builds new Date(`${day}T${time||'00:00'}:00`) in receiver's local zone; Host ticks Date.now() every second for the countdown
stubsObserved.standsInFor: server-decided seal moment and time left
stubsObserved.consequence: changing device clock opens a sealed wish; sealed wish content is already in the page

rulings: Receiver by link needs a way to find a wish without the sender's account (by wish no or an unguessable slug); the front end has none. A human must rule.
Whether the passcode/answer may travel to the receiver (it does today) or is checked server-side; unlock.ts says the latter is the plan.
Whether a receiver's ring answer (Yes) and No are stored, and what they see after: only 'Yes.' is written as text today; 'no' written verbatim.
What a receiver sees for status sealed/draft/removed/gone (today only 'resting' has a screen).
